## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change Type

- [ ] New planning package
- [ ] PRD update
- [ ] Roadmap or task update
- [ ] Architecture notes update
- [ ] Risk or decision update
- [ ] Copilot customization update (`.github/**`)

## Scope

- [ ] In-scope changes are explicit
- [ ] Out-of-scope remains unchanged

## Traceability

List affected IDs.

- Requirements: `FR-...`, `NFR-...`
- Tasks: `TASK-...`
- Risks: `RISK-...`

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Documents stay concise and decision-oriented
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are measurable where applicable
- [ ] Dependencies and assumptions are explicit
- [ ] Next actions are included when scope changed

## Validation

- [ ] `node .github/hooks/scripts/validate-prd.mjs` passes
- [ ] `bun format` was run

## Notes for Reviewers

Add any context that reviewers should know.
